Lunch: Godt Brød coffee shop (skolebrød) or Mathallen Oslo food hall
Dinner: Den Glade Gris - Norwegian pork-focused gastropub (try the ribbe or nakkekoteletter). Or RIB for slow-cooked beef ribs. After dinner, walk to Fuglen - a vintage Norwegian café-bar for a nightcap
Activities: Fly into Oslo Airport (OSL) (~$800-1,200 round trip, 7-8 hr flight); Explore Aker Brygge waterfront (Free, 1-2 hr); National Museum ($20 (200 NOK), 1.5-2 hr); Walk the city center (Free, Flexible); Oslo Opera House roof walk (Free, 20-30 min); Ekebergparken Sculpture Park (Free, 1-2 hr); Grünerløkka brewery crawl ($8-12/pint, 1-2 hr)
Group Notes: Arrive in Oslo. Keep Day 1 light - see Jet Lag Playbook. The National Museum (The Scream) and Opera House roof are must-dos. Activities during the day help power through jet lag.
Lodging: Budget: Citybox Oslo ($95/night); Mid: Radisson RED Oslo ($118/night); Premium: Grand Hotel Oslo ($285/night)
Points of Interest: Aker Brygge [59.91,10.73]; Opera House [59.9075,10.7531]; Vigeland Sculpture Park [59.9267,10.7097]; Karl Johans Gate [59.9139,10.74]; Mathallen Food Hall [59.9217,10.7567]

Directions: Take E6 north from Oslo through Gudbrandsdalen valley | Stop at Ringebu Stave Church (quick detour off E6) | Continue to Sjoa River for family rafting | Follow RV15 west to Lom
Lunch: Sjoa Rafting Center cafe - burgers, coffee, and Kvikk Lunsj for the road, or pack from Matkroken in Otta
Dinner: Fossheim Hotel restaurant - traditional Gudbrandsdalen lamb stew and local beer in a cozy 1830s timber building. After dinner, walk across the street to see Lom Stave Church lit up at night
Stops: Ringebu Stave Church ($10 (100 NOK), 20-30 min); Sjoa River rafting ($111 (1,075 NOK) half-day, 3 hr); Lom Stave Church ($12 (120 NOK), 20-30 min); Fossheim Bakeri ($5-10, 30 min)
Activities: Ringebu Stave Church ($10, 20-30 min); Sjoa River rafting ($111 half-day, 3 hr); Lom Stave Church ($12, 20-30 min); Fossheim Bakeri ($5-10, 30 min); Lom village walk (Free, 30-45 min); Medalen Disc Golf (18 holes) (Free, 1.5-2 hr)
Group Notes: Longest drive day but broken up with stops along the Gudbrandsdalen valley. Ringebu Stave Church is a quick detour off E6. The Sjoa River rafting center offers class 1-2 trips. Arrive Lom in the afternoon; Medalen Disc Golf is a free flat course right in the village. Fossheim Bakeri has Norway's best kanelboller - a great spot for pastries and coffee.
Lodging: Budget: Nordal Turistsenter ($90/night); Mid: Fossheim Hotel ($140/night); Premium: Røisheim Hotel ($250/night)
Points of Interest: Ringebu Stave Church [61.5333,10.1333]; Sjoa River [61.6833,9.5333]; Lom Stave Church [61.8378,8.5683]

Directions: Take RV15 from Lom heading northwest | Turn onto RV63 at Grotli towards Geiranger | Stop at Dalsnibba Skywalk (toll road) before descending | Descend Geirangervegen (RV63) into Geiranger village - stunning mountain switchbacks
Lunch: Café onboard the fjord cruise - salmon wrap
Dinner: Brasserie Posten at Hotel Union - Norwegian seafood platter, reindeer fillet, cloudberries for dessert with panoramic Geirangerfjord views. After dinner, use the Hotel Union spa (pools, sauna) or sit on the terrace with a nightcap
Stops: Dalsnibba Skywalk ($8 (80 NOK) toll, 20-30 min); Flydalsjuvet viewpoint (Free, 15 min)
Activities: Dalsnibba Skywalk ($8 toll, 20-30 min); Flydalsjuvet photo stop (Free, 15 min); Geirangerfjord cruise ($40-55 (400-550 NOK), 1.5-2 hr); Storseterfossen waterfall walk (Free, 1.5-2 hr)
Group Notes: Epic drive day - Dalsnibba and Flydalsjuvet are quick photo stops as you approach from the south. The fjord cruise is the afternoon highlight. Evening: explore Geiranger village.
Lodging: Budget: Grande Fjord Hotel ($180/night); Mid: Hotel Geiranger ($240/night); Premium: Hotel Union Geiranger ($320/night)

Lunch: Westerås Farm café - local goat cheese waffles and berry jam with fjord views
Dinner: Naustkroa Café in the village - traditional Norwegian fish soup and local craft beer by the Geiranger waterfront. After dinner, walk down to the fjord shore for sunset photos
Activities: RIB fjord safari ($70-90 (700-900 NOK), 1-1.5 hr); Geirangerfjord kayaking ($85-100 guided, 2-3 hr); Ørnevegen (Eagle Road) drive (Free, 45 min); Westerås Farm hike (Free, 1.5-2 hr); Skageflå mountain farm hike (Free (water taxi $15), 3-4 hr)
Group Notes: Full day in Geiranger. Morning: RIB safari. Afternoon: choose between kayaking the fjord or hiking Skageflå. Evening: dinner followed by a casual Eagle Road sunset drive.
Lodging: Budget: Grande Fjord Hotel ($180/night); Mid: Hotel Geiranger ($240/night); Premium: Hotel Union Geiranger ($320/night)
Points of Interest: Geirangerfjord Cruise Pier [62.1,7.2]; Storseterfossen Hike [62.0833,7.2167]; Flydalsjuvet Viewpoint [62.1,7.1833]; Eagle Road Viewpoint [62.1167,7.15]

Directions: Take Ørnevegen (RV63) up from Geiranger | Continue RV63 north through Valldal valley | Cross Trollstigen mountain pass (typically open for the summer season) | If Trollstigen is bypassed or unpassable, utilize the standard scenic Fv650 directly to Ålesund | Continue to Ålesund via E136 + E39
Lunch: Valldal strawberry farm café - fresh strawberry cake
Dinner: XL Diner - classic Norwegian seafood. Try the bacalao (dried salted cod stew - an Ålesund specialty since the Portuguese trade days), or the fresh catch of the day. After dinner, climb the 418 steps to Aksla viewpoint for the midnight panorama
Stops: Trollstigen Viewpoint (Free, 20-30 min); Gudbrandsjuvet Gorge (Free, 15-20 min)
Activities: Trollstigen mountain pass (Free, 30 min); Gudbrandsjuvet gorge (Free, 15-20 min); Aksla viewpoint (Free, 30-45 min); Art Nouveau architecture walk (Free, 1-1.5 hr)
Group Notes: The Trollstigen drive is a bucket-list experience. Safe rockfall protection infrastructure has significantly stabilized access seasons. If choosing to bypass, Fv650 provides a direct and highly scenic connection. Evening: walk up Aksla - 418 steps to the city viewpoint.
Lodging: Budget: Thon Hotel Ålesund ($236/night); Mid: Quality Hotel Ålesund ($170/night); Premium: Hotel Brosundet ($220/night)

Lunch: Café at Atlanterhavsparken - fish and chips with Atlantic views
Dinner: Apotekergata No. 5 - modern Norwegian shared plates in a historic Art Nouveau building. Great cocktails and local craft beer. After dinner, take a twilight stroll through the Art Nouveau streets to admire the spire-lit skyline
Activities: Atlanterhavsparken (Atlantic Sea Park) ($26 (275 NOK), 2-3 hr); Kayak Brosundet canal ($50-70 rental, 2 hr); Sukkertoppen hike (Free, 1.5-2 hr); Alnes Lighthouse (Free (toll bridge), 1 hr); Molo Brew taproom ($8-12/pint, 1 hr)
Group Notes: Flex day in Ålesund. Morning: Atlantic Sea Park. Afternoon: choose between kayaking the canals or hiking Sukkertoppen. Late afternoon: Alnes Lighthouse. Evening: Molo Brew taproom.
Lodging: Budget: Thon Hotel Ålesund ($236/night); Mid: Quality Hotel Ålesund ($170/night); Premium: Hotel Brosundet ($220/night)
Points of Interest: Atlantic Sea Park [62.466,6.095]; Aksla Viewpoint [62.4744,6.1612]; Alnes Lighthouse [62.4833,6]

Directions: Take E39 north from Ålesund towards Vestnes | Take the Vestnes–Molde ferry across the Moldefjord | Arrive in Molde and drive directly up to the Varden viewpoint
Lunch: Lunch in Ålesund before departing or onboard the ferry
Dinner: Glass Restaurant at Scandic Seilet - floor-to-ceiling Moldefjord views. Try the bacalao or pan-seared halibut. After dinner, view the late-night sky from the waterfront.
Activities: Vestnes–Molde Ferry Crossing (~$20-30, 35 min); Varden Molde Panorama (Free, 30 min); Explore Molde Rose Gardens (Free, 1 hr)
Group Notes: A light transit day making a clean forward progress northward. Drive smoothly onto the ferry at Vestnes. Spend a relaxed afternoon exploring Molde town and check the iconic mountain views from Varden before dinner.
Lodging: Budget: Thon Hotel Moldefjord ($130/night); Mid: Molde Fjordhotell ($150/night); Premium: Scandic Seilet Hotel ($200/night)

Directions: Drive north from Molde on RV64 through the Atlantic Ocean Tunnel to Averøy | Drive the iconic Atlantic Ocean Road across the 8 bridges | Stop at Kvernes Stave Church on Averøy island | Take the Kanestraum–Halsa ferry along the E39 route | Continue north along E39/E6 directly into Trondheim
Lunch: Pack lunch or stop at a seaside café near Kristiansund
Dinner: Bakklandet Skydsstation - cozy historic inn on Bakklandet cobblestone street. Reindeer stew with lingonberry jam, fresh salmon, or local specialty flatbreads. Walk across the Old Town Bridge afterward.
Stops: Atlantic Ocean Road viewpoints (Free, 30-45 min); Kvernes Stave Church ($8 (80 NOK), 20-30 min)
Activities: Atlantic Ocean Road (Free, 1 hr); Kvernes Stave Church ($8, 20-30 min); Kanestraum–Halsa Ferry (~$15-20, 20 min); Evening walk Bakklandet (Free, 45-60 min)
Group Notes: An incredible transit flow up the coast. Moving the Atlantic Road to today eliminates all back-tracking loops. Stop at Eldhusøya rest area for the safest and most cinematic photos. Catch the Kanestraum ferry and enter Trondheim seamlessly from the west.
Lodging: Budget: City Living Schøller Hotel ($110/night); Mid: Clarion Hotel Trondheim ($150/night); Premium: Radisson Blu Royal Garden ($180/night)
Points of Interest: Atlantic Road Bridges [63.0167,7.35]; Kvernes Stave Church [63.0042,7.7233]; Nidaros Cathedral [63.4267,10.3967]; Bakklandet [63.4317,10.3983]

Lunch: Kaffebrenneriet Bakklandet - best coffee and fresh pastries on the cobblestone street
Dinner: Farewell dinner at Fagn (Michelin-starred modern Norwegian tasting menu) or Speilsalen. End the trip at Trondheim Mikrobryggeri for a final local craft beer.
Activities: Nidaros Cathedral interior tour ($13 (140 NOK), 1-1.5 hr); Kristiansten Fortress (Free (grounds), 45 min); Rockheim - National Museum of Pop Music ($18 (180 NOK), 1.5-2 hr); Bakklandet & Gamle Bybro (Free, 1 hr); Last-minute Norwegian souvenirs (Variable, 1 hr)
Group Notes: Full city day in Trondheim. Morning: Nidaros Cathedral. Mid-day: Rockheim museum - interactive music exhibits. Afternoon: choose between exploring Kristiansten Fortress or shopping in Bakklandet. Evening: farewell dinner.
Lodging: Budget: City Living Schøller Hotel ($110/night); Mid: Clarion Hotel Trondheim ($150/night); Premium: Radisson Blu Royal Garden ($180/night)

Lunch: Airport lounge or grab sandwiches for the plane
Activities: Fly home from Trondheim Airport (TRD) (-, 7-8 hr flight (with connections)); Morning in Trondheim (if late flight) (Free, 1-3 hr); Duty-free at TRD (Variable, 30 min)
Group Notes: Departure day from Trondheim (TRD). Most US connections route through Amsterdam or Copenhagen. Ensure bags are checked completely through.
